vendors.description: Every registered vendor, sorted by `id` in code point order.

id.description: The vendor's id, the `<vendor-id>` of `vendor run` (`jlcpcb`).

outputs.description: The files the vendor writes, sorted by `kind`, then `format`, each in code point order.

config_schema.description: The schema id of the vendor's configuration, for example `prism.vendor.jlcpcb.config.a0`.

CliVendor.description: One registered vendor and its outputs.

version.description: The format's version, raised when the file's layout changes (cli-spec.md §5.8).

CliVendorOutput.description: One file a vendor writes: its kind, format and format version.

SchemaId.description:
Id of a JSON document schema, `<family>.<name>.<version>`: for example
`prism.stackup.a0`, `prism.bundle.manifest.a2`, `prism.system_interface.v1`
or `kicad_monkey.design.a0`. Lowercase, dot-separated, ending in the
version (`a<N>` while pre-stable, `v<N>` once stable).

CliVendorOutputKind.description: What a vendor output file holds.

CliVendorOutputFormat.description: The file format of a vendor output.

CliReleaseVersion.description:
A release version of three dot-separated decimal numbers without leading
zeros, for example `0.1.0` (SemVer), `2026.9.7` (the fork's CalVer) or
`10.0.6` (KiCad, as `kicad-cli version` prints it). Printable ASCII only,
which keeps the generator id's canonical form unambiguous (cli-spec.md §5.1).
